user.title: Tankwise setup
user.description: Enter the pump and distance entity IDs (e.g. switch.pump and sensor.tank_distance). Lower distance = fuller tank. Empty distance must be greater than full. For ultrasonic meters use values like 0.25 (full) and 0.47 (empty). After install, open the Tankwise sidebar panel to finish tuning.

data_description.pump_entity: Exact entity_id of the switch that turns the well pump on/off.
data_description.distance_entity: Exact entity_id of the numeric distance-to-water sensor (not the % sensor).
data_description.full_distance: Distance when the tank is full (smaller number).
data_description.empty_distance: Distance when the tank is empty (larger number).
